recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is recommended unless a new current publisher/tooling failure is reproduced outside the historical DSTU1 spreadsheet path.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core profiles issue reporting that adding the example string "What is the date of the patient's birth?" to the question extension failed the build because the spreadsheet parser treated the Example value as an Extension rather than the extension value element.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 4551 as the application. The corresponding git-svn commit 360171a424a2b0bdbf84d612bc7a722385214254 explicitly mentions #5814, adds the example to the old source/datatypes/elementdefinition-extensions-spreadsheet.xml source, and fixes SpreadsheetParser/TypeParser so extension value examples are parsed after the value[x] type is known.
additional_context: The old DSTU1 spreadsheet source is no longer the current authoritative build-scope source for the elementdefinition-question extension. Current fhir.ini active profile entries point at source/profiles extension spreadsheets, source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml only retains the old spreadsheet name as profile metadata, and the elementdefinition-question extension itself is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack with Extension.value[x] constrained to string.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the historical tooling/source defect was fixed by r4551 and current core plus Extension Pack source does not need an additional specification change.
